Hi Sophie — great to hear you're moving forward. Attaching a compact activation checklist (spreadsheet) and a VPC diagram template. Below is the condensed responsibilities matrix and the minimum network/security prereqs to accelerate the kick-off.

Responsibilities (recommended)
- HelioTech cloud/network owner: configure VPC peering, route table changes, NAT gateways, and provide IAM/service account contacts (HelioTech)
- HelioTech security lead: KMS/Key material owner and SOC evidence requests
- Redwood onboarding lead (Karthik): overall project owner, rollout schedule, routing policy guidance
- Redwood infra engineer (Naomi): service account and bastion setup, TLS cert exchange, test plan
- Redwood sales/ops (Ben): contract/procurement liaisons, billing & capacity commitments

Minimum network/prereqs (short)
- Outbound egress: allow HTTPS (443) to our control plane endpoints in us-west-2; we provide IP ranges and DNS entries during intake.
- Inbound: none required unless you request an inbound bastion for debugging; we strongly prefer outbound-only model.
- NAT/Ports: allow ephemeral egress for container images and telemetry; ports 443 and 5222 for agent telemetry (if agent used).
- IP allowlist: we will provide a /28 range for optional allowlisting; NAT egress is supported.
- KMS: we support customer-managed KMS with RSA 2048; exchange of key alias and IAM role required.
- ASN/Routing: if you're using Direct Connect/private peering, please confirm ASN and if you plan to advertise prefixes to our infra (we typically accept static routes; BGP optional).
- Service accounts: short-lived service principal with limited IAM perms (we provide a template).

Quick next steps:
1) HelioTech to assign cloud/network and security owners and share contact emails.
2) HelioTech to complete the attached "mep-service-roles.csv" with IAM/service-account contact names.
3) Redwood to schedule a 60-min technical intake (we'll bring infra + security).

Attachments: privdeploy-activation-checklist-v1.xlsx; heliotech-vpc-diagram-v2.png; mep-service-roles.csv

--
